What is a Rest Card, and why did we build it? Here's how it can turn your lowest day into a 10,000-step day.

You're showing up every day, building a habit and making progress.

But let's be honest. Not every day is going to be a 10,000-step day. And that's okay!

Koshiqa is built with feedback from members like you.

One day, a woman from our community sent us a message that really stayed with us. She said she sees Koshiqa as her lifelong sustainable partner. But during her period days, she sometimes doesn't want to push herself to 10,000 steps. She wants to give her body some rest. And then she asked us something simple: "Can we have some rest days in the contest?" That got us thinking.

That's one of the reasons we built the Rest Card.

It finds your lowest eligible step day in the contest and automatically lifts it to 10,000 steps.

Let's say your lowest day had 4,200 steps. Your Rest Card can add 5,800 steps, bringing that day up to 10,000.

Because we believe fitness should be sustainable, not stressful. Some days you push yourself. Some days you give your body a little rest.

And we'll keep building Koshiqa with you, every step of the way.
